data.name: Manorama
data.gender_notes: Manorama is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Manorama is a Sanskrit name meaning 'delight of the mind'. In Hindu mythology, Manorama is a divine beauty, a form of the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. The name Manorama carries the meaning “Delight of the mind” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Manorama usually hope their child will grow to embody delight of the mind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Manorama belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight of the mind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manorama total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
